{
  "dataset_name": "pol",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "base_level_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average min-max normalized level over f5 through f9, with each component clipped to training-fold observed bounds.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "base_signal_level",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Supplies a bounded common-scale average over the dense leading block, reducing scale imbalance for a linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.clip((f5 - 13.0) / 187.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((f6 - 77.0) / 123.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((f7 - 76.0) / 124.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((f8 - 71.0) / 129.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((f9 - 94.0) / 78.0, 0.0, 1.0)) / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "base_high_excess_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Mean positive excess of f5 through f9 above their training-fold averages, normalized by each variable upper slack.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "base_signal_excess",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Highlights high-end excursions with smooth nonnegative values that can move an SVM margin without separate hard cutoffs.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.maximum(f5 - 76.354, 0.0) / 123.646 + np.maximum(f6 - 94.37755555555556, 0.0) / 105.62244444444444 + np.maximum(f7 - 83.86066666666666, 0.0) / 116.13933333333334 + np.maximum(f8 - 75.42355555555555, 0.0) / 124.57644444444445 + np.maximum(f9 - 95.95044444444444, 0.0) / 76.04955555555556) / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "base_dispersion_norm",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Within-row spread across f5 through f9, computed as clipped max-minus-min over the leading variable block.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "base_signal_shape",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures contrast among leading readings, giving the margin a compact measure of disagreement within the row.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(1.0 * f5, f6), f7), f8), f9) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(1.0 * f5, f6), f7), f8), f9)) / 187.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "base_trend_projection",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed slope-like projection over normalized f5 through f9, contrasting earlier positions with later positions.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "base_signal_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Approximates a directional trend in the dense leading block, giving a signed projection suitable for a linear boundary.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((-2.0 * np.clip((f5 - 13.0) / 187.0, 0.0, 1.0) - np.clip((f6 - 77.0) / 123.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((f8 - 71.0) / 129.0, 0.0, 1.0) + 2.0 * np.clip((f9 - 94.0) / 78.0, 0.0, 1.0)) / 3.0, -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mid_block_log_load",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled total activity across f13 through f19, normalized by the sum of training-fold observed upper bounds.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sparse_count_load",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses several sparse counts into one stable load measure, reducing sparsity effects for the margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(1.0 * f13 + f14 + f15 + f16 + f17 + f18 + f19) / np.log1p(931.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "tail_block_log_load",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-scaled total activity across f20 through f33, normalized by the sum of training-fold observed upper bounds.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sparse_count_load",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth aggregate for the later sparse block, helping the SVM use magnitude without being dominated by spikes.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.log1p(1.0 * f20 + f21 + f22 + f23 + f24 + f25 + f26 + f27 + f28 + f29 + f30 + f31 + f32 + f33) / np.log1p(1022.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "sparse_activity_density",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average saturating activation score across f13 through f33, where each count contributes x divided by x plus 5.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sparse_count_breadth",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Approximates breadth of active sparse positions while limiting the influence of very large individual counts.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((f13 / (f13 + 5.0) + f14 / (f14 + 5.0) + f15 / (f15 + 5.0) + f16 / (f16 + 5.0) + f17 / (f17 + 5.0) + f18 / (f18 + 5.0) + f19 / (f19 + 5.0) + f20 / (f20 + 5.0) + f21 / (f21 + 5.0) + f22 / (f22 + 5.0) + f23 / (f23 + 5.0) + f24 / (f24 + 5.0) + f25 / (f25 + 5.0) + f26 / (f26 + 5.0) + f27 / (f27 + 5.0) + f28 / (f28 + 5.0) + f29 / (f29 + 5.0) + f30 / (f30 + 5.0) + f31 / (f31 + 5.0) + f32 / (f32 + 5.0) + f33 / (f33 + 5.0)) / 21.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "mid_tail_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed ratio comparing total activity in f13 through f19 with total activity in f20 through f33.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sparse_count_balance",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives a relative-allocation feature so the margin can respond to where sparse activity is concentrated.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(((1.0 * f13 + f14 + f15 + f16 + f17 + f18 + f19) - (1.0 * f20 + f21 + f22 + f23 + f24 + f25 + f26 + f27 + f28 + f29 + f30 + f31 + f32 + f33)) / (1.0 * f13 + f14 + f15 + f16 + f17 + f18 + f19 + f20 + f21 + f22 + f23 + f24 + f25 + f26 + f27 + f28 + f29 + f30 + f31 + f32 + f33 + 1.0), -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "count_location_projection",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Centroid-like signed projection over f13 through f33, with earlier positions receiving negative weights and later positions receiving positive weights.",
      "value_range": [
        -1.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sparse_profile_projection",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Turns shifts in sparse-position activity into one normalized signed score that can be used directly by a linear SVM.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((-10.0 * f13 - 9.0 * f14 - 8.0 * f15 - 7.0 * f16 - 6.0 * f17 - 5.0 * f18 - 4.0 * f19 - 3.0 * f20 - 2.0 * f21 - 1.0 * f22 + 1.0 * f24 + 2.0 * f25 + 3.0 * f26 + 4.0 * f27 + 5.0 * f28 + 6.0 * f29 + 7.0 * f30 + 8.0 * f31 + 9.0 * f32 + 10.0 * f33) / (10.0 * (1.0 * f13 + f14 + f15 + f16 + f17 + f18 + f19 + f20 + f21 + f22 + f23 + f24 + f25 + f26 + f27 + f28 + f29 + f30 + f31 + f32 + f33 + 1.0)), -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "count_spike_concentration",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Largest single count among f13 through f33 divided by total activity across those positions plus one.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "sparse_profile_concentration",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures dominance of one sparse position compared with total activity, useful for patterns hidden by aggregate load.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(f13, f14), f15), f16), f17), f18), f19), f20), f21), f22), f23), f24), f25), f26), f27), f28), f29), f30), f31), f32), f33) / (1.0 * f13 + f14 + f15 + f16 + f17 + f18 + f19 + f20 + f21 + f22 + f23 + f24 + f25 + f26 + f27 + f28 + f29 + f30 + f31 + f32 + f33 + 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "profile_coherence_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric assessor score of whether f5 through f9 and f13 through f33 form a coherent row pattern, such as a smooth trend or one dominant region, rather than scattered unrelated peaks; 0.0 means incoherent and 1.0 means highly coherent.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_profile_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a compact shape-regularity cue that a linear SVM can weight directly when raw measurements interact in non-additive ways.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "unusual_profile_severity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Numeric assessor score of how unusual the row profile appears relative to training-fold ranges and typical spreads for f5 through f9 and f13 through f33; 0.0 means ordinary and 1.0 means highly unusual due to simultaneous high levels, broad activation, or isolated spikes.",
      "value_range": [
        0.0,
        1.0
      ],
      "feature_family": "semantic_profile_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a bounded unusualness cue for multicolumn profiles that may otherwise require nonlinear combinations.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
